capabilities: Render bare URLs as adaptive link cards in Reading view, Live Preview, and Canvas
Fetch and cache page metadata and preview images, including hotlink-protected images
Tint cards with the dominant color of the preview image
Strip tracking parameters from pasted and existing URLs
Restore Threads and Instagram share links to their canonical URLs
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a network usage disclosure listing every request it makes and states there is no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian shows bare URLs as plain text and Canvas embeds them as live web pages, with no rich, self-contained link preview cards.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the link previews in Apple Freeform, Notes, and Bear

summary: Renders bare URLs as rich link preview cards in Reading view, Live Preview, and Canvas, with color tinting, cached images, and tracking-parameter stripping.
